names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Ιάκωβος του Βρυλέεφ», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 11 апреля ст. ст., name page 870, «Иаков Брылеевский, прп.», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line gives the name in the genitive. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the stored form as a key no other folder holds.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Ιάκωβος του Βρυλέεφ έζησε στη Ρωσία κατά τον 15ο αιώνα μ.Χ.». The page gives no year of birth and none of death, and its heading carries no years.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «Преподобный Иаков скончался в XV веке и был погребен во Введенской церкви» — he reposed in the fifteenth century, which is a statement about the death where saint.gr’s was about the life, so it is recorded beside the floruit and not in place of it. Neither page gives a year. Read 7 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Иакова Железноборовского (1442) и Иакова Брылевского, сподвижника его (XV).»
source.note: One line for the two men, the teacher with his year and the disciple with his century. **The line and the name page spell the disciple differently** — «Иакова Брылевского» in the genitive on the day line against «Иаков Брылеевский» on the name page — and the name page’s form is the one stored, being the calendar’s own nominative.

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Ιάκωβος του Βρυλέεφ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no years. The same 11 April page keeps his teacher as a separate entry, and the two are told apart by their houses and their dates: this man is of the Bryleyevo hermitage and of the fifteenth century, the other of Zheleznyi Borok and dead in 1442. The page spells his master's house two ways within one sentence, «μονή Ζέλεζνιυ-Μπορόκ» and «Αγίου Ιακώβου του Ζελενί-Μπορ», and his own hermitage «έρημο Βρυέεφ» where the day's line has «Βρυλέεφ»; all of those readings are the page's. It prints no couplet and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
